niche: a regional grocery chain's six-month field trial of a vendor's machine-learning forecast for fresh ordering in hand-picked stores, read against the stores that kept the ERP's own forecast: why the pilot stores' fresh sales grew less and their waste fell much more than the rest, split into causes, then what switching would save a year in each store format and which formats to switch for 2027
answer: to be filled when the pack is cut: the store formats Fjordkob switches to the new fresh forecast for 2027, each format's expected yearly saving per store against the licence, and the causes of the pilot stores' two gaps
analyst_test: The careful but hurried pass conforms both daily extracts and the weekly history, reproduces the dashboard's two gaps, separates the competitor openings and the formats' different growth, then prices empty shelves from in-stock weekday averages with nothing recaptured and reads each format's saving off that format's pilot stores, so it lands the competitor and format components and misses the units lost to empty shelves, the recapture, what the saving depends on, two of the three format savings and the call.
domain_test: Every result is a statistician's object on a field trial with a capped outcome and a hand-picked sample: demand rebuilt from sales capped by stock through each stockout's last-sale time and an in-stock intraday profile, a recapture rate estimated from paired items' sales on the days the other ran out, a difference-in-differences separated from a concurrent shock with an outcome the trial cannot touch, and a heterogeneous effect carried to the population it would be rolled out to through a moderator rebuilt from each store's own history; swap the nouns for hospital wards or call centres and there is no stock that caps the recorded outcome, no paired item that recovers part of it and no weekly trading shape for a chain-wide model to misread.
layer1: two daily extract layouts across an ERP export change (semicolons and decimal commas against a dotted export)
store-days re-sent by the extract job (the same store, item and date twice)
waste scanned the next morning and booked to the following day
last-sale time blank on days with no sale
a weekly business-intelligence history whose category codes were renamed at the 2026 range review
closing stock below zero on a few rows where a delivery was booked late
stakeholder_role: the chain's head of supply chain planning, who takes the 2027 fresh-forecast licence to the board

spine.file: to be filled when the pack is cut
spine.entity: one store, fresh item and day

world.geography: Denmark (East Jutland: Aarhus, Randers, Horsens, Silkeborg, Skanderborg and Vejle)
world.org_type: a regional grocery chain with three store formats (Super, neighbourhood and To Go at stations and office districts) and a central fresh warehouse

driver: A trial of a new decision system in hand-picked units looks better than it is for three separate reasons, each estimated from a different file: the outcome each unit records is capped by the system's own choices, so the loss it causes never appears and is rebuilt from when each capped record stopped and how the rest of such a day normally runs, with part of the loss recovered by a paired alternative at a rate that differs by unit type; a concurrent shock and a composition difference sit inside the same comparison and are separated with a record the system cannot touch; and the units tried were picked for a property that also governs how much the system helps, so the benefit for the population it would be rolled out to is carried through a moderator rebuilt from each unit's own history rather than read off the trial's own units.
driver_concrete: Fjordkob's fresh-forecast pilot shows its 16 pilot stores cutting waste far more than the other 32 while their fresh sales grew less: the vendor's lean forecast empties shelves earlier in the day, which the dashboard's at-close availability barely registers, so the units lost are rebuilt from each stockout's last-sale time against the in-stock hourly profile and netted of what the paired item recaptured, which differs by format; competitor openings near some stores and the formats' different growth sit in the same gap and are separated with the ambient sales record the forecast never touches; and the regional managers picked their busiest, weekend-trading stores while the vendor's chain-wide weekly pattern over-orders weekends and under-orders weekdays in commuter-week stores, so each format's yearly saving is carried through each store's own weekend share, not read off the pilot stores of that format.
stump: A careful but hurried solver reproduces the dashboard, runs the before-and-after against the other stores by format, prices empty shelves from in-stock weekday averages or not at all and nets nothing for the paired item, and reads the To Go format off its three pilot stores, so it switches every format, or Super alone if it prices each lost unit at full margin, because it never rebuilds the lost units from the stockout times, never nets the recapture and never asks whether the pilot's To Go stores trade like the format's commuter stores.
results: R1 the pilot stores' two headline gaps reproduced from the reconciled record (fresh sales growth and waste change against the same weeks of 2025, pilot against the rest); R2 the units each store group could not sell because the shelf was empty, by period; R3 the share of those units customers bought as the paired item instead, by format; R4 the competitor openings' effect on fresh sales growth, separated with the ambient record; R5 the sales growth gap split into its causes; R6 the waste gap split into its causes; R7 what the forecast's saving depends on in a store (its own weekend share) with the evidence; R8 each format's expected yearly saving per store from switching; R9 its 80 per cent range; R10 the formats to switch
one_fact_test: to be measured by effort.py once the pack is cut; designed so the most useful single sentence ('the new forecast reads every store's week like a big weekend store's') rescues R7, R8 and R10 at most, 3 of 10
strategy_label: WORKS IN FORM (heterogeneity that pooling hides, weighted to the population the decision serves, with the group property rebuilt from history; outcomes that have not finished happening read as demand the stock cut off), own chain

differentiation.task15: architecture 1 split a quoted index's shortfall under filed heads on a staged breeding record (selection on noisy means, a transported response to season water, lodging) and nominated two lines; architecture 2 is a retail field trial whose recorded outcome is capped by the system on trial, with a concurrent shock, a recapture rate and a moderator carried to the rollout population, decided per store format, in another world, dataset and shell

lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-11 at the author's word before upload: the judge's Gate H read the stump power as moderate (a run giving every line its own response to season water earns the nominations, 59.0 to 70.0 on the paper scale), and the author asked for a re-root with at least three major analytical failure points in new areas
lineage.driver: Candidates picked each year on a noisy internal score keep underdelivering on an outside yardstick for three separate reasons that each have to be estimated from the whole internal record (the luck that got them picked, which shrinks by how much each was observed; a reference unit that gains more than they do along a condition the outside yardstick sits far up, by an amount that differs from candidate to candidate, a condition the internal record cannot tell from overall level and the outside record can; and a recorded weakness whose cost grows there), so the gap between the two means is split under filed heads until nothing is left of it, and the next candidates are rebuilt from all three and the ones to expect most from put up.
